title: FIRST topluluk keşfi ve geliştirici tasarımı
goal: Herkesin aktif projelerini ana sayfada göster ve FIRST tasarımını geliştirici ekosistemine uygun yeniden kur

assumptions: User explicitly replaces prior warm palette with a GitHub-inspired developer design.
Source inspection only; standard deployment health checks permitted.
Public feed includes consented project text and classification only, no repository data or personal information.

constraints: Kullanıcı aksini söylemediyse accepted entegrasyon mantıksal commitlerle main branch'e push edilir; alt writerlar bağımsız push yapmaz ve force-push yasaktır.
Backend servisleri ve lokal Docker agent makinesinde başlatılmaz.

decisions.summary: User-requested full redesign replaces previous warm palette with a GitHub-inspired dark developer workspace.
decisions.reason: Latest user asks complete visual revision plus everyone’s projects on home; shared tokens and all workflow behavior retained.

items.title: backend
items.objective: Anonymous paginated feed lists all active project shares without GitHub calls or private repository/account data.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous paginated feed lists all active project shares without GitHub calls or private repository/account data.

items.title: frontend
items.objective: Home consumes real public project feed; GitHub-inspired shared design covers all existing workflows, responsive states and accessible controls.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Home consumes real public project feed; GitHub-inspired shared design covers all existing workflows, responsive states and accessible controls.

items.title: review
items.objective: Independent source review accepts feed privacy/pagination and complete frontend redesign.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Independent source review accepts feed privacy/pagination and complete frontend redesign.

items.title: verify
items.objective: Manager verifies final source against feed and redesign acceptance.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Manager verifies final source against feed and redesign acceptance.

items.title: integration
items.objective: Accepted backend/frontend deployed and push hashes and deployment results recorded.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepted backend/frontend deployed and push hashes and deployment results recorded.
